note: ACCOUNT.JOURNAL NOW HAS NONE. 154 -> 151, three names in addons/account/models/account_journal.py, each renamed for what it does rather than for the mechanical arrow the gate prints. _ensure_unique_alias returns a sanitized, disambiguated alias name and raises nothing, so the gate suggestion _check_ would be wrong twice over -- §2.4 reserves _check_ for constraints -- and it is _get_unique_alias_name. _ensure_bank_account links a bank account, creating one through set_bank_account when given a number, and trusts it; it checks nothing, so it is _link_bank_account. _fill_missing_values mutates the create vals in place and takes the canonical _update_ for the abolished fill. All three were file-local: the only other callers of a _fill_missing_values in any of the four checkouts belong to account.intrastat.report, an unrelated model. Measured at 2b0f19c18a3 in a detached worktree carrying only this change.
